notes.description: Internal HTML notes about the job, surfaced to the hiring team in the Greenhouse UI.

job_name.description: Internal job title shown to the hiring team. When omitted, the template job's name is used.

office_ids.description: Ids of the offices to assign the job to. A job can span multiple offices. Mutually exclusive with external_office_ids.

opening_ids.description: Optional partner-supplied identifiers for the openings being created. One entry per new opening, paired positionally with number_of_openings; entries may be null. Each value is stored on the resulting opening as its opening_id (a free-form string).

custom_fields.description: Values to set on this job's custom fields. Each entry identifies the field by custom_field_id or name_key and supplies a value whose shape matches the field's value_type.

department_id.description: Id of the department to assign the job to. Mutually exclusive with external_department_id.

job_post_name.description: External-facing title for the job's initial internal job post (the listing shown on the company's careers site). Defaults to job_name when omitted.

requisition_id.description: Partner-supplied external identifier for the requisition (e.g. an HRIS or ATS code). Free-form string and not required to be unique.

template_job_id.description: Id of an existing job (typically a template) used as the source for the new job's interview plan, scorecards, hiring team, and approval workflow. Required.

number_of_openings.description: Number of openings to create on the new job. Each opening can be filled by a single hire. Total open openings on a job cannot exceed Greenhouse's internal limit of 100.

external_office_ids.description: Partner-supplied external_id values of the offices to assign the job to. Mutually exclusive with office_ids.

external_department_id.description: Partner-supplied external_id of the department to assign the job to. Mutually exclusive with department_id.

id.description: Id of the approver group in which to swap an approver. Only approvers in unresolved groups may be replaced.

remove_user_id.description: Greenhouse user id of the existing approver to remove from the group.

search.description: Free-text query matched against the candidate full-text search index (name, email, and related candidate text).

prospect.description: Filter by application kind. true returns only prospect applications; false returns only non-prospect applications; omit to return both.

stage_ids.description: Return only applications whose current interview pipeline stage matches one of these ids (up to 50).

job_post_ids.description: Return only applications submitted through these job post ids (up to 50).

referrer_ids.description: Return only applications attributed to these referrer ids (up to 50). These are referrer ids, not user ids.

candidate_ids.description: Return only applications belonging to these candidate ids (up to 50).

candidate_tag_id.description: Return only applications whose candidate carries this candidate tag id.

hiring_manager_id.description: Return only applications on jobs with this hiring manager (a user id).

sequential.description: When true, approver groups resolve one tier at a time in sort_order; when false, all groups are activated in parallel.

custom_fields.update.title: Update Greenhouse custom field
custom_fields.update.description: Update Greenhouse custom field via authenticated Harvest PATCH /v3/custom_fields/{id}. Accepts Composio snake_case aliases.

id.description: The Greenhouse id of the custom field to update.

name.description: New display name for the custom field. Omit to leave the name unchanged.

private.description: Whether the field is private (visible only to users with the appropriate permission). Offer fields are always private.

api_only.description: Whether the field can only be updated through the API (not the Greenhouse UI). Requires the Harvest-only Custom Fields feature to be enabled for the organization.

required.description: Whether the field must be filled in before the associated object can be saved.

description.description: New description for the custom field. Pass an empty string to clear it, or omit to leave it unchanged.

require_approval.description: Whether changing this field triggers a re-approval. Applies to job and opening fields only.

template_token_string.description: Token used to reference this field in email and offer templates. Set or change it on an existing field.

expose_in_job_board_api.description: Whether the field is included in the Job Board API responses. Applies to job fields only.

sort_order.description: Integer controlling where this option appears relative to the field's other options. Lower values are shown first. Omit to leave the order unchanged.

parent_id.description: Id of the department to move this department under, repositioning it in the department tree. Omit to leave the parent unchanged.

name.description: Internal job title displayed to the hiring team in Greenhouse.

notes.description: Internal HTML notes for the hiring team. Replaces the existing value when supplied.

department_id.description: Set the job's department by Greenhouse id. Mutually exclusive with external_department_id.

requisition_id.description: Partner-supplied external requisition identifier. Pass an empty string to clear.

external_office_ids.description: Replace the job's office assignments using partner-supplied office external_id values. Mutually exclusive with office_ids.

how_to_sell_this_job.description: Internal selling-points note for recruiters pitching the role.

external_department_id.description: Set the job's department by partner-supplied external_id. Mutually exclusive with department_id.

team_and_responsibilities.description: Internal description of the team and the role's responsibilities.

cursor.description: Harvest v3 cursor from Link rel=next.

body.description: New free-text body for the job note. Newline characters (\n) are stored verbatim and rendered as line breaks in the Greenhouse UI. Omit to leave the existing body unchanged.

cursor.description: Harvest v3 cursor from Link rel=next.

name.description: New display name for the office. Required by the Greenhouse API. Must be unique within the organization and less than 255 characters.

location.description: Free-form text representation of the office's geographic location. Not geo-located by Greenhouse.

parent_id.description: Office id to nest this office under as a child. Requires the Advanced or Expert package. Mutually exclusive with external_parent_id.

external_id.description: Partner-supplied external identifier for the office, used for cross-system reconciliation. Expert package only. Must be unique within the organization.

on_behalf_of.description: Greenhouse user id of the user performing this action, sent as the On-Behalf-Of request header. Required by Greenhouse for write operations for auditing purposes.

external_parent_id.description: External id of the parent office, used as an alternative to parent_id. Expert package only. Mutually exclusive with parent_id.

primary_in_house_contact_user_id.description: Id of the Greenhouse user to set as the office's primary internal contact. When provided, this user will be listed as the primary in-house contact for the office.

openings.update.title: Update Greenhouse opening
openings.update.description: Update Greenhouse opening via authenticated Harvest PATCH /v3/openings/{id}. Accepts Composio snake_case aliases.

id.description: Numeric Greenhouse id of the opening to edit. This is the immutable internal id, not the free-text opening_id.

opening_id.description: New partner-supplied external identifier for the opening (a free-form string, may be blank, max 255 characters). Changing this may re-trigger approvals depending on the job's state.

custom_fields.description: Custom field values to update on the opening. Each entry identifies a field by id or name_key and supplies the new value. Updating a custom field may reset official job approvals depending on the field's settings.

close_reason_id.description: Numeric id of the close reason to record. Only valid when status is 'closed'; supplying it without closing returns an error.

target_start_on.description: Target start date for a hire filling this opening, in ISO 8601 date format (YYYY-MM-DD). Pass null to clear.

users.update.title: Update Greenhouse user
users.update.description: Update Greenhouse user via authenticated Harvest PATCH /v3/users/{id}. Accepts Composio snake_case aliases.

id.description: The id of the user to update.

last_name.description: User's last name. Cannot be blank if supplied. Max 255 characters.

first_name.description: User's first name. Cannot be blank if supplied. Max 255 characters.

office_ids.description: Ids of the offices to assign to the user. Replaces the user's existing office assignments wholesale.

employee_id.description: Partner-supplied external employee identifier (e.g. an HRIS id). Send an empty string to clear it.

custom_fields.description: List of custom field values to set on the user. Replaces the user's existing custom fields wholesale. Each entry must supply either name_key or custom_field_id together with a value.

department_ids.description: Ids of the departments to assign to the user. Replaces the user's existing department assignments wholesale.

external_office_ids.description: External ids of the offices to assign to the user. Alternative to office_ids; replaces the user's existing office assignments wholesale.

external_department_ids.description: External ids of the departments to assign to the user. Alternative to department_ids; replaces the user's existing department assignments wholesale.
